premise: Geologist tells Excavator to dig but can't remember the word for stop; the pile grows until the buggy can't get past — and the magic word turns out to be please.
inspiration: Grimm's 'Sweet Porridge' (the pot that won't stop cooking), turned: the magic word was manners all along.

en-US.title: Stop, Little Digger!
en-US.text: {geologist:enter} Geologist needed a rock from deep down. {geologist:face happy} Dig, {excavator:enter} Excavator, dig! he said. {excavator:live hold} And Excavator dug. Scoop. Scoop. Scoop. {canvas:dust 8s} Grey dust flew up in clouds. {geologist:live} Geologist found his rock and studied it. Perfect! You can stop now. Scoop. Scoop. {geologist:face surprised} Stop! Halt! Enough! {excavator:shake} Scoop. Scoop. Scoop. The pile grew, and grew. {buggy:enter} Along came the buggy — and {buggy:live} spun its wheels against the pile. Wheeee… {geologist:face sad} [sighs] What was the word? He tried everything. Freeze! Whoa! Off! [pause] Then he remembered. {geologist:face happy} Please stop, Excavator. {excavator:live resume} And Excavator stopped. [giggles] You only had to ask nicely, it rumbled. {buggy:pulse} So the buggy went the long way round.

es-ES.title: ¡Para, excavadora!
es-ES.text: {geologist:enter} Geólogo necesitaba una roca de muy abajo. {geologist:face happy} ¡Cava, {excavator:enter} Excavadora, cava! dijo. {excavator:live hold} Y Excavadora cavó. Paletada. Paletada. Paletada. {canvas:dust 8s} El polvo gris salía volando en nubes. {geologist:live} Geólogo encontró su roca y la estudió. ¡Perfecta! Ya puedes parar. Paletada. Paletada. {geologist:face surprised} ¡Para! ¡Alto! ¡Basta! {excavator:shake} Paletada. Paletada. Paletada. El montón crecía, y crecía. {buggy:enter} Llegó el buggy… y {buggy:live} hizo girar las ruedas contra el montón. Rrrrrr… {geologist:face sad} [sighs] ¿Cuál era la palabra? Lo probó todo. ¡Quieta! ¡So! ¡Apágate! [pause] Y entonces se acordó. {geologist:face happy} Para, Excavadora, por favor. {excavator:live resume} Y Excavadora paró. [giggles] Solo tenías que pedirlo con educación, retumbó. {buggy:pulse} Así que el buggy dio la vuelta larga.

scoop.prompt: a digging machine's toothed drum scooping gravelly dust, a rhythmic crunchy scrape, playful
